entry.title: self-evolve

Closes six concrete self-deception paths (grader tampering, un-verifiable anchors, holdout overfit, judge collusion, correlated-anchor e-value inflation, covert outbound exfil) with an anytime-valid PACE acceptor, IMMUTABLE decision-code isolation for self-bootstrapping, and crash-replay determinism.
